Engine Maintenance Tiers

Select → Performance → Ultimate → High Mileage

These tiers apply primarily to engine oil and oil filter maintenance. Other systems follow their own specifications, capacities, intervals, and requirements.

Specialties include European and heavy-duty applications, with vehicle applications from 1973–2026.

Why This Matters

Your Vehicle Determines the Maintenance Path

The platform does not begin with a generic product catalog. It begins with your exact vehicle, identifies the applicable requirements, and connects those requirements to the corresponding Vehicle-Specific Maintenance products.

Spend less time guessing, avoid unnecessary product searches, and make more informed maintenance decisions for the vehicle you depend on every day.

About & Our Story

Where My Automotive Journey Began

My automotive involvement began in 2011. The specification matters: the right product isn't simply about what is available. It is about what actually applies to the vehicle.

2011

Where My Automotive Journey Began

My automotive involvement began in 2011. What started with an interest in vehicles grew into a deeper understanding of how they work, how their systems differ, and why the right product depends on the specific application.

Over time, I became increasingly interested in: vehicle applications, parts, fluids, filters, maintenance requirements, product specifications, sourcing, and how different vehicles require different solutions.

One thing became clear: THE SPECIFICATION MATTERS.

Learning Through the Vehicle

The more I learned, the more I began looking at automotive supply differently. Instead of asking: "WHAT PRODUCT DO I HAVE?" I started asking: "WHAT DOES THIS VEHICLE REQUIRE?"

That change in perspective became the foundation for what would eventually become Automotive Supply & Solutions. Year, make, model, engine, drivetrain, configuration, mileage, operating conditions, maintenance requirements — all of these can affect what applies. The vehicle has to come first.

2020 — The Detailing Business

It's About the Customer

In 2020, I started a detailing business. That experience gave me another perspective on the automotive industry. It wasn't only about the vehicle or the products anymore. It was about the customer.

People want to know that the products being used on their vehicle are appropriate. They want reliable supplies, clear information, quality, organization, and confidence in the decisions being made.

AUTOMOTIVE SUPPLY ISN'T JUST ABOUT PRODUCTS. It's also about helping people understand what they need and why it applies.

The Question That Changed My Direction

WHY SHOULD FINDING A PRODUCT START WITH THE PRODUCT? Why should a customer have to search through products first and then try to determine whether something fits? Why not start with the vehicle?

Year → Make → Model → Engine → Drivetrain → Configuration

Then determine: what does the vehicle require? Which maintenance system applies? Which fluids, filters, parts, or supplies may apply? Which products match those requirements? That became the idea behind the platform.

Why We Start With the Vehicle

When someone says: "THIS IS MY VEHICLE." That gives us somewhere meaningful to begin.

Identify → Understand → Organize → Match → Select

The goal is to make the process easier for customers who may not know every specification, part number, or product category. YOUR VEHICLE SHOULD BE THE STARTING POINT.

Why I Call It Supply & Solutions

I chose the name Automotive Supply & Solutions because the vision goes beyond simply selling products. Supply can include: parts, fluids & lubricants, filters, maintenance products, tools, equipment, and service supplies.

But the bigger goal is connecting those supplies to an actual need.

Vehicle → Requirements → Supply → Solution

A customer isn't necessarily looking for a product just because they want a product. They're usually trying to solve something: maintain the vehicle, prepare for service, replace a required component, find the correct fluid or filter, keep a vehicle operating properly. That's why the focus is Supply & Solutions.

Building Vehicle Intelligence

One of the most important parts of the platform is Vehicle Intelligence. The purpose is to organize vehicle information before connecting it to products. This can include: year, make, model, engine, drivetrain, configuration, mileage, fluid specifications, fluid capacities, filter requirements, maintenance intervals, operating conditions, and applicable maintenance systems.

Know the Vehicle → Understand the Requirements → Find What Applies

This is the foundation of the vehicle-first approach.

My Approach

I believe automotive product selection should start with the vehicle, not the product.

Year → Make → Model → Engine → Drivetrain → Configuration

Vehicle → Requirements → Supply → Solution

This approach is designed to help customers better understand what applies to their vehicle before they begin selecting products. The goal is to make automotive supply more: ORGANIZED → UNDERSTANDABLE → RELEVANT.

What I'm Building

Automotive Supply & Solutions is being developed as a vehicle-first platform connecting: Customers → Vehicles → Requirements → Products & Supplies → Solutions.

Rather than simply presenting a large selection of automotive products, the platform is being structured to help customers start with their vehicle and work toward the supplies and solutions that may apply.

Your Vehicle → Your Requirements → Your Supply & Solutions

What This Means For You

You shouldn't have to know every part number or understand every product category before getting started. The platform is being built to help you move from: "I need something for my vehicle." to: "I understand what my vehicle requires and what I should be looking for."

Whether you're maintaining your daily driver, planning routine maintenance, caring for a higher-mileage vehicle, or sourcing automotive supplies, the vehicle is the starting point.

The Long-Term Vision

System Provider First → Service Provider After

The system comes first — building the vehicle information, Vehicle Intelligence, supply structure, sourcing process, and customer experience. As that foundation grows, additional automotive services can be developed around it.

Build the System → Serve the Customer → Grow the Solutions
